body_axes: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; metres in the current robot rigid-body frame
purpose: Independent medium and propulsion-readiness observations for the execution layer

other_observations.attitude: estimated or explicitly marked simulator ground truth

transition_design.LAND_to_HYBRID: Persistent front wetness while grounded: permit a transition blend, keep submerged-thruster limits
transition_design.HYBRID_to_WATER: Both propellers have adequate immersion and ground support remains low for a dwell interval
transition_design.WATER_to_HYBRID: Persistent track ground contact; restore track authority gradually
transition_design.HYBRID_to_LAND: Ground support is stable and wetness or measured draft is below the calibrated exit threshold
transition_design.anti_chatter: Debounce, separate entry/exit thresholds and minimum dwell; initial 0.3-1.0 s is a calibration range, not a validated constant
transition_design.ambiguous_or_missing: Retain a conservative transition state or stop when propulsion readiness cannot be established; do not infer WATER solely from no ground contact

simulation_requirements: Wet probes are custom synthetic sensor channels, not an assumed built-in Isaac water sensor.
Use each probe pose and the local water surface to synthesize only local wetness; add declared latency, noise and splash/dropout conditions.
Thruster hub wetness alone does not establish full propeller immersion; check blade-top clearance or a calibrated immersion estimate.
A wet-contact channel cannot prove that the hull is afloat; combine it with support load, attitude and optional pressure/draft.
Current switch policy uses simulated buoyancy and native contact forces as a reference. Preserve it as a separately labeled baseline until the sensor policy is validated.
No new collision geometry is attached by this file; real mounting and clearance require review against the track envelopes.
Log raw measurements, filtered measurements, requested mode, applied mode and transition reason with simulation timestamps.
Never send privileged water-region labels, buoyancy forces or new sensor channels to MSGNav or OmniNav.
